note: Small family-owned grill, bar and campground just south of Cameron, near the junction of Hwys 53, 8 and SS, between the Red Cedar River and the Chetek chain of lakes, with ATV trails in the area. The sites sit among pines and hardwoods, and dogs are welcome. Mostly seasonal: about 11 of its 31 sites are sold by the night. --Claude
summary: Operator pages confirm $40 back-in / $45 pull-through (weekly/monthly/seasonal too), 31 sites, water + 30/50-amp, dump, CampLife booking (11 sites online). Mostly seasonal (11 of 31 nightly, 35%): kept-with-caveat band. Google 4.6 (230, shared with the bar). Not waterfront kept.
flags: LONG-STAY (private): mixed. Operator: 'We have 31 campsites which include seasonal, daily, and weekly rates!' and 'We also have many seasonal sites. We currently have availability for the 2027 season.' CampLife's site list (2026-10-14) sells 11 sites (1-5, 8-13), all open on 2027-06-08 => ~35% nightly. Five tests: (1) price $40 back-in, under $50; (2) nightly rate posted on its own site + CampLife sells one night; (3) no minimum stated; (4) 11/31 nightly (>=1 in 10); (5) RV park, no homes/lots sold. Passes; 10-50% band, so the note carries the 'Mostly seasonal' line. No wording discouraging nightly guests.
Google Maps 'Buck & Beam's Grill, Bar, & Campground' 4.6 (230 reviews) - the listing is shared with the grill and bar, so not the campground's alone. RV Life 4.5 / $$ (stored).
Price gate: $40 back-in base (CampLife $44.72 with its once-a-stay fee, June 2027), under $50; Good Sam false (derived, left).

Rates page shows two blocks: the labelled 'Nightly : Back-in $40 / Pull Thru $45 / Weekly $240 / Monthly $600' and an unlabelled 'Nightly $35 / Weekly $210 / Monthly $550 / Seasonal $1,800 (plus electricity)' (possibly tent or older rates; the page doesn't say). Base kept at $40.

ATV: the operator lists ATV trails among area activities ('From your campsite, you can quickly be to ... ATV trails'); not a trail-system camp. The old note's 'right on the ATV trails' dropped as unstated.
Waterfront: not waterfront kept (no water at the park).

Phone 715-458-2990 and website https://www.bucknbeams.com confirmed (Google + CampLife record). Website line 2 'https://www.camplife.com/campground/Buck+'N+Beam's' could become the operator's own link https://www.camplife.com/Buck+%27N+Beam%27s?newres=y (minor).
Season not posted; CampLife answered 'The park is closed at this time' for 2026-10-17/20 and 2027-01-26/30 (2026-10-14 capture).
